messages.subject: [Rcicr-users] Combining Rdata from two stimulus sets
messages.subject_clean: [Rcicr-users] Combining Rdata from two stimulus sets
messages.body_plain:
Hi

I created two stimulus sets so that I could randomly assign participants to
one or the other set. I did this so I could infer that differences were not
due to a particular stimulus set.

However, I'd like to combine data from participants' responses to both
sets. How do I do this? Thank you!

Nick

-- 
Nick Michalak

messages.subject_clean: [Rcicr-users] Combining Rdata from two stimulus sets
messages.body_plain:
Dear Nick,

How did you create the two sets? Did you generate the stimuli in one go and then took one half for one participants and another half for other participants? Or did you generated stimuli twice using a different random seed to create separate stimulus sets (resulting in two .Rdata files, one for each stimulus set)?

Best,

Ron
